title: Ores Regenerator
description: A lightweight plugin that automatically regenerates ores across the world over time, with per-ore timers and configurable settings for which ores can renew and whether they appear underground or on the surface.
body:
# ⛏️ Ore Regenerator - `PrabhatPie`

A lightweight Minecraft plugin that **automatically regenerates ores across the world over time**, keeping survival worlds renewable and balanced without manual intervention.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🌍 **Global Ore Regeneration** – Ores naturally reappear across the world
- ⏱️ **Per-Ore Timers** – Set different renewal times for each ore
- 🪨 **Surface & Underground Support** – Control whether ores generate exposed or hidden
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** – Enable/disable specific ores
- 🚫 **Anti-Exploit System** – Avoids regenerating near players
- 🌱 **Natural Distribution** – Mimics vanilla ore spawning patterns
- 🔄 **Automatic System** – No manual interaction required

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
- Set renewal time in **hours**
- Enable/disable individual ores
- Control surface generation
- Limit regeneration per cycle
- Define Y-level ranges

---

## 📜 Commands
> This plugin is designed to be automatic, but optional admin commands can be included:

- `/orereload` – Reload config
- `/orestatus` – View next regeneration cycle

---

## 🔐 Permissions
- `orerenew.admin` – Access admin commands

---

## 🧩 Use Cases
- SMP servers with long-term worlds  
- Economy-based servers needing renewable resources  
- Survival servers avoiding world resets  
- Realistic gameplay with resource balancing  

---

## 💡 Summary
> Keeps your world alive by **naturally restoring ores over time**, ensuring players never run out of resources while maintaining a vanilla-friendly experience.
